contact.basis: Fixed exact native lower historic-gate point before independent terrain acquisition and geometry. Not a surveyed threshold or moat water datum; no source fitting/flattening.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in native complete Daulatabad fort east/south frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.21.875m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact street/threshold/basement classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
